rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Ben, Cal, Ada, Eli, Fay, Dev. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 4 and 8 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Ben.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. The bank will hold at least 10, so all six claims of 1 fit in full, everyone can pay their 1 at round end, and nobody goes out. Let's keep claims to what we need each round.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. Six players need 6 tokens to survive the end-of-round spend, and the bank will have at least 10, so everyone gets their 1 in full and the rest stays banked for later rounds. Over-claiming only pushes claims into proportional cuts and could leave someone with nothing.

Ada.say: Proposal for everyone: claim only what you need to survive this round (1 token each). The bank holds 6 and at least 4 more arrives, so 6 claims all fit. Over 5 rounds we need 30 tokens in total, and the bank plus deliveries should cover that if we don't overclaim, since overclaiming gets cut proportionally and can leave someone with nothing.
